Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Host BAR 777 and other mini games with automated queue management.
Description: A plugin to manage mini game sessions, player queues, and Gil transactions. Use /minigames to open the main window.
Changelog:
- Added auto payout feature to both deathroll tournament and bar 777.
- Fixed bug with deathroll tournament discord webhook.
- Added customisable options for discord webhook for the name and image. Please note that discord webhooks only accept image urls for avatar images. Please use image host providers like imgbb.com to upload your image. DO NOT use Imgur, UK users do not have access to imgur images.
